description: 경상북도 칠곡군_버스운행 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경상북도 칠곡군. 본 데이터는 경상북도 칠곡군 관내 시내버스 운행 에 대한 데이터입니다. 시내버스 노선번호, 주요경유지, 출발지, 목적지 등의 정보를 제공합니다. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
